me55.name: 30th Celebration
me55.source: Six-card special set (Pikachu Rare + 3 main-set foils + 1 hit slot + basic Energy, all foil); one hit slot per pack, leftover is a regular Rare. IR 1 in 5, Classic Collection 1 in 10, SIR 1 in 21 and Futuristic Rare 1 in 120 from TCGplayer's study of 3,000 English packs, reported by PokeBeach (Sep 2026). ex (Double Rare) 1 in 4 and RGB Mew 1 in 3,200 from @switchstock's 6,500-pack tally (reported by Sports Illustrated, Sep 2026); TCGplayer could not pin the RGB rate. Cross-checked against tcgtalk.com (652 packs: ex 21.9%, IR 18.4%, Classic 9.8%, SIR 5.5%, FUR 1.2%) and pullrates.com (FUR 1 in 103). The RGB Mew rate is the least certain figure. No god packs reported.

me1.name: Mega Evolution
me1.source: Source: TCGPlayer Authentication Center — 5,000+ packs physically opened (September 2025). Rates corroborated by PokeBeach, Screen Rant, Game Rant, RubyGator.nl, and Cardrake. Precise figures from UltimaSupply citing TCGPlayer raw data: DR 20.91% ±1.12%, UR 8.23% ±0.76%, IR 10.89% ±0.86%, SIR 0.99% ±0.27%, MHR ~0.0794% (1 in 1,260). EU single booster pack price €5.00 based on Cardmarket live listings (May 2026). Sample size exceeds 5,000 packs — data considered reliable.

me2.name: Phantasmal Flames
me2.source: Pull rates sourced from TCGPlayer's official 5,000-pack study (reported by PokeBeach, Nov 2025) and corroborated by a 10,000+ pack community aggregate (tcgprotectors.com, Jan 2026) combining YouTube mass openings, Reddit r/PokeInvesting tallies, and X/Twitter live pulls. DR: 1/5 packs, IR: 1/9 packs, UR: 1/12 packs, SIR: 1/80 packs, MHR: 1/1260 packs. EUR pack price is estimated standard EU retail MSRP; secondary market prices are higher. Sample size exceeds 10,000 packs — data confidence is high.

me2pt5.name: Ascended Heroes
me2pt5.source: Rates sourced from TCGPlayer's study of 2,000+ packs (god packs excluded), published Feb 24–26 2026, corroborated by PokeBeach, EternaCards, Cardrake, and Card Codex. DR: 1 in 5 packs; IR: 1 in 9 packs; UR: 1 in 21 packs (reduced from ~1 in 12 in prior sets because Mega Attack Rares displace the UR slot); SIR: 1 in 70 packs (22 SIRs in pool); MHR: 1 in 540 packs. Pack price EUR estimated at €5.00 — Ascended Heroes is a special set (no booster boxes), sold only in ETBs, Bundles and Collection products; individual pack EUR SRP aligns with standard Mega Evolution era pricing. Sample size is solid (2,000+ packs), confidence level: HIGH.

me3.name: Perfect Order
me3.source: Community-sourced rates. DR (1 in 5) and IR (1 in 9) from obsidia-tcg.store (3,500+ packs) and riporfliptcg.com (500+ packs, citing Pokebeach data) — sample size is sufficient. UR (1 in 12 per obsidia / 1 in 18 per comicbook 55-pack sample) — averaged to ~1 in 12 from the larger dataset. SIR (1 in 72–81 across multiple sources with 381–3,500+ packs). MHR (1 in 1,786 per obsidia 3,500+ pack dataset; 1 in 1,250 per riporfliptcg 500-pack sample) — high variance, treat as estimate only. EU pack price estimated at €4.50 based on European booster box retail of €130–€160 / 36 packs (tcgradar.eu). No Limitless TCG pull-rate page found for this set. TCGPlayer article exists but requires JS to render.

me4.name: Chaos Rising
me4.source: Primary source: TCGplayer Authentication Center (8,500+ packs opened, published ~June 4 2026). DR ~20% (rare slot), UR ~8% (rare slot), IR ~11% (reverse holo slot), SIR ~1% (reverse holo slot, ~1 per 100 packs), MHR ~0.1% (~1 per 1,000 packs). Corroborated by @switchstock on X (5,000+ packs) and josephwriteranderson.com (5,000+ pack dataset). TCGtalk sample of 268 packs aligns on IR/UR but SIR/MHR estimates less reliable at that size. EU pack price estimated at €4.50 based on Mega Evolution series MSRP parity with Phantasmal Flames and Perfect Order; Cardmarket live pricing was unavailable at time of query.

me5.name: Pitch Black
me5.source: Primary source: obsidia-tcg.store (4,000+ packs, cross-confirmed by TCGPlayer 4,000-pack sample via cardrake.com). Secondary: tcgtalk.com (753 packs, 21 boxes). DR ~1 in 5 packs (20.0%); IR ~1 in 9 packs (11.1%); UR ~1 in 12 packs (8.3%); any SIR ~1 in 80 packs (1.25%); MHR ~1 in 1,081 packs (0.093%). EUR pack price is the current tracked market low per pokecompare.com (6.95 EUR); no official EU MSRP single-pack price was published. Limitlesstcg.com did not carry pull rate data for this set at time of query.

sv10.name: Destined Rivals
sv10.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center study of 8,000+ English packs (Peter Day, 'Pokémon TCG: Destined Rivals Pull Rates', TCGplayer, May 30, 2025: https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Destined-Rivals-Pull-Rates/43ba832e-44c9-45a4-ae2e-594df2defdda/). Unrounded per-pack rates with 95% intervals: Double Rare 19.83% ± 0.84% (1 in 5), Ultra Rare 6.39% ± 0.52% (1 in 16), Illustration Rare 8.29% ± 0.58% (1 in 12), Special Illustration Rare 1.06% ± 0.22% (1 in 94), Hyper Rare 0.67% ± 0.17% (1 in 149). DR and UR sit in the rare slot; IR, SIR and Hyper Rare in the second reverse slot. Per card: DR 1 in 86, UR 1 in 344, IR 1 in 278, SIR 1 in 1,033, Hyper Rare 1 in 894. No ACE SPEC in this set.

sv9.name: Journey Together
sv9.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center, 8,000+ English packs opened for launch: 'Pokémon TCG: Journey Together Pull Rates' (tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Journey-Together-Pull-Rates/1b9f379f-97cb-45cc-b6f6-a1a070a422cd/, published 2025-03-28, updated 2025-05-29). Per pack, 95% confidence: Double Rare 20.29% ± 0.85% (1 in 5), Ultra Rare 6.54% ± 0.52% (1 in 15), both in the rare slot; Illustration Rare 8.50% ± 0.59% (1 in 12), Special Illustration Rare 1.16% ± 0.23% (1 in 86), Hyper Rare 0.73% ± 0.18% (1 in 137), all in the second reverse slot. Each card of a rarity is equally likely (specific SIR 1 in 518). No ACE SPEC. pullrates.com cites the same study but rounds to generic SV figures (DR 1 in 6, IR 1 in 13), so it is not used.

sv8pt5.name: Prismatic Evolutions
sv8pt5.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center, 1,200+ English packs opened before release: 'Pokémon TCG: Prismatic Evolutions Pull Rates' (https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Prismatic-Evolutions-Pull-Rates/d94889ea-f76a-4a13-b74d-5b0b071220a7/, updated 2025-01-27), 95% confidence intervals: Poké Ball Foil 33.10% ± 2.60% (1 in 3, first reverse holo slot), Double Rare 16.51% ± 2.05% (1 in 6), Ultra Rare 7.46% ± 1.45% (1 in 13), ACE SPEC Rare 4.68% ± 1.17% (1 in 21, first reverse holo slot), Master Ball Foil 4.92% ± 1.19% (1 in 20, second reverse holo slot), Special Illustration Rare 2.22% ± 0.81% (1 in 45, per-pack average), Hyper Rare 0.56% ± 0.41% (1 in 180). DR and UR sit in the rare slot; SIR and Hyper Rare in the second reverse slot. No Illustration Rares. Poké Ball prints exist for all 100 Commons, Uncommons and Rares, Master Ball prints for the 67 Pokémon among them (not Double Rares). Reported by PokeBeach (https://www.pokebeach.com/2025/01/prismatic-evolutions-pull-rates-revealed-special-illustration-rares-twice-as-easy-to-pull). God packs (Master Ball Eevee plus the SIR Eevee ex and Eeveelutions) and demigod packs (three SIRs) exist, but TCGplayer could not count them, so they are not modelled; the SIR rate above is the average per pack.

sv8.name: Surging Sparks
sv8.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center study of more than 8,000 English packs (https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Surging-Sparks-Pull-Rates/6ccfb6ab-f26a-4ce8-bab5-5f91c85ec70e/, published 2024-11-08, updated 2025-02-27), with 95% intervals: DR 16.94% ±0.79 (1 in 6), UR 6.74% ±0.53 (1 in 15), ACE SPEC 5.03% ±0.46 (1 in 20, in the first reverse slot), IR 7.67% ±0.56 (1 in 13), SIR 1.15% ±0.22 (1 in 87), Hyper Rare 0.53% ±0.15 (1 in 188). IR, SIR and Hyper Rare share the second reverse slot. Cross-checked against tcgtalk.com's 500-pack case opening (DR 85, UR 34, ACE 25, IR 39, SIR 7, HR 5), inside TCGplayer's intervals except SIR and HR, which 500 packs cannot pin. No English god packs reported.

sv7.name: Stellar Crown
sv7.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center study of 8,000+ English packs (published 2024-09-13, updated 2025-02-27), per pack with 95% intervals: Double Rare 16.90% ±0.79% (1 in 6), Ultra Rare 6.75% ±0.53% (1 in 15), ACE SPEC Rare 4.94% ±0.46% (1 in 20, first reverse slot), Illustration Rare 7.79% ±0.57% (1 in 13), Special Illustration Rare 1.11% ±0.22% (1 in 90) and Hyper Rare 0.73% ±0.18% (1 in 137), all three in the second reverse slot. TCGplayer found Dachsbun ex (067) at 0.76% ±0.18% against about 1.24% for each other Double Rare and calls it likely short printed, so data/sv7.json gives it pullWeight 0.61. Same rates as Temporal Forces and Twilight Masquerade; no god packs in English Scarlet & Violet.

sv6pt5.name: Shrouded Fable
sv6pt5.source: Three community counts, taking the middle figure for each rarity. Dripshop (via PokéPatch, https://pokepatch.com/2025/05/24/shrouded-fable-pull-rates-in-pokemon-tcg-set/): DR 1/6, UR 1/15, ACE SPEC 1/20, IR 1/12, SIR 1/67, Hyper Rare 1/144. Mark van Zee, 2,354 packs, Aug 2024 (https://www.skool.com/pokemon/shrouded-fable-pull-rates): IR 1/12, full-art Pokémon 1/24 plus full-art Supporter 1/36 (UR 1/14.4 combined), SIR 1/64, gold 1/118. ThePriceDex (https://www.thepricedex.com/set/sv6pt5/shrouded-fable/pull-rates): DR 1/6, ACE SPEC 1/20, IR 1/13, UR 1/14.3, SIR 1/87, Hyper Rare 1/128. Reverse holo basic Energy: no count published; 1 in 6 is an estimate from TCGplayer prices (a reverse Energy sells for about 1.7x a reverse Common, Sep 2026). No god packs.

sv6.name: Twilight Masquerade
sv6.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center, 8,000+ English booster packs opened before release (Peter Day, 'Pokémon TCG: Twilight Masquerade Pull Rates', May 2024, updated Feb 2025: https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Twilight-Masquerade-Pull-Rates/f3eea967-e5fb-4108-8655-bb1c89587628/). Per pack, 95% confidence: Double Rare 16.93% ±0.79% (1 in 6, rare slot), Ultra Rare 6.61% ±0.52% (1 in 15, rare slot), ACE SPEC Rare 5.06% ±0.46% (1 in 20, first reverse slot), Illustration Rare 7.73% ±0.56% (1 in 13), Special Illustration Rare 1.17% ±0.23% (1 in 86) and Hyper Rare 0.68% ±0.17% (1 in 146), the last three in the second reverse slot. Reported by PokeBeach: https://www.pokebeach.com/2024/05/twilight-masquerade-pull-rates-revealed-gold-cards-just-slightly-rarer. Pack: 4 Commons, 3 Uncommons, 2 reverse slots, 1 rare slot and a basic Energy.

sv5.name: Temporal Forces
sv5.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center, 8,000+ English packs opened before release: 'Pokémon TCG: Temporal Forces Pull Rates' by Peter Day (https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Temporal-Forces-Pull-Rates/28c0ad22-00a4-428f-b22d-e7fee9ec50bc/, updated 2025-02-27), 95% confidence intervals: Double Rare 16.83% ± 0.79% (1 in 6), Ultra Rare 6.67% ± 0.53% (1 in 15), ACE SPEC Rare 5.00% ± 0.46% (1 in 20, replaces the first reverse holo), Illustration Rare 7.72% ± 0.56% (1 in 13), Special Illustration Rare 1.17% ± 0.23% (1 in 86), Hyper Rare 0.72% ± 0.18% (1 in 139). DR and UR sit in the rare slot; IR, SIR and Hyper Rare in the second reverse slot. Reported by PokeBeach (2024-03) and ScreenRant (2024-03-29); ThePriceDex and tcgtalk.com carry the same figures. No god packs in English Temporal Forces.

sv3.name: Obsidian Flames
sv3.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center, 8,000+ English packs opened before release (Peter Day, 'Pokémon TCG: Obsidian Flames Pull Rates', tcgplayer.com, updated Feb 2025), 95% confidence intervals: Double Rare 13.61% ±0.72% (1 in 7), Ultra Rare 6.63% ±0.52% (1 in 15), Illustration Rare 7.60% ±0.56% (1 in 13), Special Illustration Rare 3.13% ±0.37% (1 in 32), Hyper Rare 1.92% ±0.29% (1 in 52). DR and UR take the rare slot; IR, SIR and gold take the second reverse slot. No ACE SPEC in this set. https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Obsidian-Flames-Pull-Rates/e2a66999-a7b5-4621-9765-c9a132e04bd2/

sv2.name: Paldea Evolved
sv2.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center, 8,000+ English booster packs opened before release (article by Peter Day, https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Paldea-Evolved-Pull-Rates/1b7d3e70-9542-4a50-8692-1661e2316521/). Per pack, 95% confidence: Double Rare 13.72% ± 0.73% (1 in 7) and Ultra Rare 6.64% ± 0.53% (1 in 15) in the rare slot; Illustration Rare 7.70% ± 0.56% (1 in 13), Special Illustration Rare 3.17% ± 0.37% (1 in 32) and Hyper Rare 1.76% ± 0.28% (1 in 57) in the second reverse holo slot. Same figures on pullrates.com, which cites the same study. No ACE SPEC in this set (they start in Temporal Forces).

sv4.name: Paradox Rift
sv4.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center, 8,000+ English packs opened before release (article 'Pokémon TCG: Paradox Rift Pull Rates', 2023-11-04, https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Paradox-Rift-Pull-Rates/0b5fb648-38fc-4f61-a6af-57c2737b4a48/). Per pack, 95% intervals: Double Rare 15.57% ±0.76% (1 in 6), Ultra Rare 6.64% ±0.53% (1 in 15), Illustration Rare 7.70% ±0.56% (1 in 13), Special Illustration Rare 2.11% ±0.30% (1 in 47), Hyper Rare 1.22% ±0.23% (1 in 82). DR and UR in the rare slot; IR, SIR and HR replace the second reverse holo. No ACE SPEC in this set. Cross-checked against pullrates.com (same study).

sv1.name: Scarlet & Violet
sv1.source: TCGplayer's study of 8,000+ English Scarlet & Violet packs (published Mar 31, 2023, updated Feb 27, 2025): Double Rare 1 in 7.3, Ultra Rare 1 in 15, Illustration Rare 1 in 13, Special Illustration Rare 1 in 32, gold Hyper Rare 1 in 54 (https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Scarlet-Violet-Pull-Rates/a7702fce-dd64-4a58-beb1-0f871c853215/; PokeBeach chart: https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2024/03/Scarlet-and-Violet-Pull-Rates.png). Cross-checked against Card Shop Live's 1,728 packs (DR 13.54%, UR 6.48%, IR 7.52%, SIR 3.01%, gold 1.85%; https://cardshoplive.com/pages/hit-rates-for-pokemon-tcg-scarlet-and-violet). The first Scarlet & Violet set: no ACE SPEC, no god packs, Double and Ultra Rares share the rare slot, IR/SIR/gold share the second reverse slot.

sv4pt5.name: Paldean Fates
sv4pt5.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center, more than 1,500 English packs opened before release: 'Pokémon TCG: Paldean Fates Pull Rates' by Peter Day (https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Paldean-Fates-Pull-Rates/23de3e93-0d0f-4ae0-abc4-13664f3001a3/, 2024-01-26), 95% confidence intervals: Double Rare 15.89% ± 1.69% (1 in 6), Ultra Rare 6.61% ± 1.15% (1 in 15), Shiny Rare 25.44% ± 2.01% (1 in 4), Shiny Ultra Rare 7.72% ± 1.23% (1 in 13), Illustration Rare 7.22% ± 1.20% (1 in 14), Special Illustration Rare 1.72% ± 0.60% (1 in 58), Hyper Rare 1.61% ± 0.58% (1 in 62). DR and UR sit in the rare slot; Shiny Rare and Shiny Ultra Rare replace the first reverse holo (about 1 pack in 3 has a shiny); IR, SIR and Hyper Rare sit in the second reverse slot.

sv3pt5.source: TCGplayer Authentication Center, "Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—151 Pull Rates" (1,500+ English packs, published 2023-09-22, updated 2025-02-27; https://www.tcgplayer.com/content/article/Pok%C3%A9mon-TCG-Scarlet-Violet%E2%80%94151-Pull-Rates/b237df74-fbb0-40d0-9e13-d69ee6e804d9/). Rare slot: DR 13.28% ±1.57 (1/8), UR 6.44% ±1.13 (1/16), else a holo Rare. Second reverse slot: IR 8.50% ±1.29 (1/12), SIR 3.11% ±0.80 (1/32), gold Hyper Rare 1.94% ±0.64 (1/51), else a reverse. Energy slot: Cosmos holo basic Energy 24.83% ±2.00 (1/4). Cross-checked against DigitalTQ's 700-pack tally (DR 13.3%, UR 6.0%, IR 7.7%, SIR 3.6%, HR 2.9%), inside or overlapping TCGplayer's bands. Demigod packs (a starter's basic IR, Stage 1 IR and ex SIR; Dexerto reported a real Charizard one, 2024-02-23) have no measured rate: 1 in 1,300 is a community guess and the least certain figure here.

sm10.name: Unbroken Bonds
sm10.source: Elite Fourum tallies, English, per pack, all reaching us through one forum: burpies 'Pull Rates in Sun & Moon - Sword & Shield Sets' https://www.elitefourum.com/t/25220 (YouTube/Twitch box openings) and sturzflugbombardieru's 'The English Pokemon card rarity guide' https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/140 (box-ratio tables per set, pooling his own full-box data with Derium, TheGameCapital 2,592 packs and Danny Phantump https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4TCjfoHoUqk); set post https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/153. No Prism Star cards in this set, so the reverse slot is always a reverse holo. The rare slot holds a plain Rare unless it rolls a holo Rare, a GX (TAG TEAM included), a full art (Rare Ultra: full-art GX, TAG TEAM, alternate art or Trainer), a rainbow or a gold. Pack: 1 Energy, 5 Common, 3 Uncommon, 1 reverse, 1 rare slot (TCGplayer product text, Bulbapedia Booster pack (TCG)). Cross-check only (not independent): ThePriceDex https://www.thepricedex.com/set/sm10/unbroken-bonds/pull-rates. Pooled over 10,405 packs: GX 9.85% (1 in 10), full art 4.11% (1 in 24), rainbow 1.44% and gold 0.91% (E2 per-card counts over 6,517 packs pooled with burpies' 3,888; the split is 62:38, not the 14:6 card ratio, because the six golds print more often); holo Rare 16.67% (1 in 6, sturzflug's own 2,845 packs, the only tally; ThePriceDex also says 1 in 6).

sm11.name: Unified Minds
sm11.source: Elite Fourum tallies, English, per pack, all reaching us through one forum: burpies 'Pull Rates in Sun & Moon - Sword & Shield Sets' https://www.elitefourum.com/t/25220 (YouTube/Twitch box openings) and sturzflugbombardieru's 'The English Pokemon card rarity guide' https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/140 (box-ratio tables per set, pooling his own full-box data with Derium, TheGameCapital 2,592 packs and Danny Phantump https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4TCjfoHoUqk); set post https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/154. No Prism Star cards in this set, so the reverse slot is always a reverse holo. The rare slot holds a plain Rare unless it rolls a holo Rare, a GX (TAG TEAM included), a full art (Rare Ultra: full-art GX, TAG TEAM, alternate art or Trainer), a rainbow or a gold. Pack: 1 Energy, 5 Common, 3 Uncommon, 1 reverse, 1 rare slot (TCGplayer product text, Bulbapedia Booster pack (TCG)). Cross-check only (not independent): ThePriceDex https://www.thepricedex.com/set/sm11/unified-minds/pull-rates. Pooled over 11,628 packs: GX 12.78% (1 in 8, all tallies 10.8 to 12.9%), full art 4.29% (1 in 23), rainbow 1.36% and gold 0.89% (E2 per-card counts over 7,956 packs pooled with burpies' 3,672); holo Rare 13.89% (1 in 7.2, sturzflug's own 4,284 packs, the only tally; ThePriceDex's 1 in 7.2 reproduces his model). Unified Minds has fewer holos and more GX than the other three sets of 2018-19.

sm6.name: Forbidden Light
sm6.source: Three tallies pooled, n=3,668 packs, 95% intervals: Elite Fourum rarity guide by sturzflugbombardieru, per-card counts of complete booster boxes (https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/147 for sm6, /148 for sm7, /149 for sm75) (n=1,404), burpies (https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pull-rates-in-sun-moon-sword-shield-sets/25220) (n=1,264) and Derium's 1,000-pack YouTube opening (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-4YQhlzYN1E, counts reached through the Elite Fourum table only): GX 7.94% (1 in 12.6), Prism Star 8.04% (1 in 12.4), full art 3.90% (1 in 26), rainbow 1.23% (1 in 81), gold 0.90% (1 in 111). Prism Stars sit in the reverse-holo slot, not the rare slot (Elite Fourum https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/140 and /146 "Prism Star cards, which appear in the reverse slot"; PokeBeach https://www.pokebeach.com/forums/threads/forbidden-light-packs-with-5-prism-cards.147088/ "Prism Star cards take the place of the Reverse Holo"; Bleeding Cool https://bleedingcool.com/games/the-cards-of-pokemon-tcg-sun-moon-ultra-prism-part-3/; and arithmetic: the rare-slot classes already sum to every pack without them), so the Prism rate replaces reverse holos at that rate per pack. Plain Rare is exactly 2/3 of packs (939 of 1,404 counted, 66.9%; the same 66.5 to 67.0% in every Sun & Moon set) and the holo-or-better slot is 12.0 packs per 36 (Elite Fourum box-ratio table https://efour.b-cdn.net/uploads/default/original/3X/8/b/8b49b311c2aa928e671b5350ab0673cefd7cd754.png), so holo = 1/3 minus the hits (19.37%). Rainbow and gold are split from the raw per-card counts, pooled 45:33. Gold is Trainers and Energy only. Whole analysis: research/second-source-check.md. Pack: 1 basic Energy, 5 Commons, 3 Uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare slot; wrapper 'ADDITIONAL 10 GAME CARDS' plus the Energy (Face to Face Games, ToyWiz and GoNintendo product text; Bulbapedia 'Booster pack (TCG)').

sm7.name: Celestial Storm
sm7.source: Four tallies pooled, n=4,720 packs, 95% intervals: Elite Fourum rarity guide by sturzflugbombardieru, per-card counts of complete booster boxes (https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/147 for sm6, /148 for sm7, /149 for sm75) (n=1,800), burpies (https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pull-rates-in-sun-moon-sword-shield-sets/25220) (n=1,480), Derium (n=1,008) and a PokeBeach shop owner's 12 boxes (n=432, https://www.pokebeach.com/forums/threads/celestial-storm-pull-rates.147911/): GX 11.14% (1 in 9), Prism Star 5.51% (1 in 18), full art 3.71% (1 in 27), rainbow 1.32% (1 in 76), gold 0.85% (1 in 118); the samples agree within their intervals. Prism Stars sit in the reverse-holo slot, not the rare slot (Elite Fourum https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/140 and /146 "Prism Star cards, which appear in the reverse slot"; PokeBeach https://www.pokebeach.com/forums/threads/forbidden-light-packs-with-5-prism-cards.147088/ "Prism Star cards take the place of the Reverse Holo"; Bleeding Cool https://bleedingcool.com/games/the-cards-of-pokemon-tcg-sun-moon-ultra-prism-part-3/; and arithmetic: the rare-slot classes already sum to every pack without them), so the Prism rate replaces reverse holos at that rate per pack. Plain Rare is exactly 2/3 of packs (1,199 of 1,800 counted, 66.6%, the PokeBeach thread notes white-code cards as plain Rares) and holo-or-better is 12.0 packs per 36, so holo = 1/3 minus the hits (16.31%; E2's own holo count is 5.82 per box against 5.87 here). Rainbow:gold pooled 62:40. Gold is Trainers and Energy only. Whole analysis: research/second-source-check.md. Pack: 1 basic Energy, 5 Commons, 3 Uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare slot; wrapper 'ADDITIONAL 10 GAME CARDS' plus the Energy (Face to Face Games, ToyWiz and GoNintendo product text; Bulbapedia 'Booster pack (TCG)').

sm75.name: Dragon Majesty
sm75.source: Two tallies pooled, n=949 packs (they may share some videos): Elite Fourum rarity guide by sturzflugbombardieru, per-card counts of complete booster boxes (https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/147 for sm6, /148 for sm7, /149 for sm75) (n=560; every one of the 560 packs had a holo or better in the rare slot) and burpies (https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pull-rates-in-sun-moon-sword-shield-sets/25220) (n=389): GX 14.96% (1 in 6.7), Prism Star 10.22% (1 in 10), full art 6.32% (1 in 16), rainbow 2.53% (1 in 40), gold 1.48% (1 in 68); the rainbow and gold intervals are about 1 point wide. Structure: no plain Rare exists, so the rare slot is always a Rare Holo or better (Flipside Gaming Collector's Dossier https://flipsidegaming.com/blogs/pokemon-blog/sun-and-moon-dragon-majesty-collectors-dossier 'at least one holographic rare card and there are no non-holo rares'; Elite Fourum's sheet model and count agree), holo = 1 minus the hits (74.71%). Prism Stars sit in the reverse-holo slot, not the rare slot (Elite Fourum https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/140 and /146 "Prism Star cards, which appear in the reverse slot"; PokeBeach https://www.pokebeach.com/forums/threads/forbidden-light-packs-with-5-prism-cards.147088/ "Prism Star cards take the place of the Reverse Holo"; Bleeding Cool https://bleedingcool.com/games/the-cards-of-pokemon-tcg-sun-moon-ultra-prism-part-3/; and arithmetic: the rare-slot classes already sum to every pack without them), so the Prism rate replaces reverse holos at that rate per pack. Dragon Majesty's reverse slot also holds 9 reverse basic Energy (Flipside dossier and Elite Fourum https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/149, both '65 reverse' prints); their 6.7% rate is a sheet model only and is not wired because the set's card data has no reverse Energy cards. Whole analysis: research/second-source-check.md. Pack: 1 basic Energy, 5 Commons, 3 Uncommons, 1 reverse holo, 1 rare slot; wrapper 'ADDITIONAL 10 GAME CARDS' plus the Energy (Face to Face Games, ToyWiz and GoNintendo product text; Bulbapedia 'Booster pack (TCG)'). No booster box was printed; packs sold loose and in the Elite Trainer Box and collections.

sm8.name: Lost Thunder
sm8.source: Elite Fourum tallies, English, per pack, all reaching us through one forum: burpies 'Pull Rates in Sun & Moon - Sword & Shield Sets' https://www.elitefourum.com/t/25220 (YouTube/Twitch box openings) and sturzflugbombardieru's 'The English Pokemon card rarity guide' https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/140 (box-ratio tables per set, pooling his own full-box data with Derium and Danny Phantump https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4TCjfoHoUqk); set post https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/150. Prism Star cards replace the reverse holo in some packs (E2 'special cards inserted in the reverse slot'; PrimetimePokemon http://primetimepokemon.blogspot.com/2018/02/prism-star-cards-pokemon-tcg.html; Dripshop 'appear in the reverse holo slot'), so they are a reverse-slot roll, never the rare slot. The rare slot holds a plain Rare unless it rolls a holo Rare, a GX (no TAG TEAM in this set), a full art (Rare Ultra: full-art GX, alternate art or Trainer), a rainbow or a gold. Pack: 1 Energy, 5 Common, 3 Uncommon, 1 reverse, 1 rare slot (TCGplayer product text '10 cards and 1 basic Energy', Bulbapedia Booster pack (TCG)). Cross-check only (not independent): ThePriceDex https://www.thepricedex.com/set/sm8/lost-thunder/pull-rates. Pooled over 5,450 packs (sturzflug 3,168, burpies 1,274, Derium 1,008): GX 10.17% (1 in 9.8), full art 4.40% (1 in 22.7), holo Rare 16.59% (the rare slot is a plain Rare in exactly 2 packs in 3 and holo-or-better in 1 in 3, so holo is 1/3 minus the hits: sturzflug's direct counts of plain Rares in every Sun & Moon set are 66.5 to 67.0% (n=1,296 to 4,968 packs per set, https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/141 and following), confirmed in kind by the mappable-box reports, https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pokemon-sun-and-moon-booster-boxes-mappable/15673, and the code-card colour, Bulbapedia Code card; his own Lost Thunder holo count is 16.75%, ThePriceDex says 1 in 6), Prism Star 12.46% (1 in 8, n=4,442: burpies 12.17%, sturzflug 12.58%). Rainbow 1.25% and gold 0.92% from E2's per-card counts (51 rainbow + 37 gold in 4,176 packs) pooled with burpies' split (1.33% / 1.02%, n=1,274).

sm9.name: Team Up
sm9.source: Elite Fourum tallies, English, per pack, all reaching us through one forum: burpies 'Pull Rates in Sun & Moon - Sword & Shield Sets' https://www.elitefourum.com/t/25220 (YouTube/Twitch box openings) and sturzflugbombardieru's 'The English Pokemon card rarity guide' https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/140 (box-ratio tables per set, pooling his own full-box data with Derium and Danny Phantump https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4TCjfoHoUqk); set post https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/151. Prism Star cards replace the reverse holo in some packs (E2 'special cards inserted in the reverse slot'; PrimetimePokemon http://primetimepokemon.blogspot.com/2018/02/prism-star-cards-pokemon-tcg.html; Dripshop 'appear in the reverse holo slot'), so they are a reverse-slot roll, never the rare slot. The rare slot holds a plain Rare unless it rolls a holo Rare, a GX (TAG TEAM included), a full art (Rare Ultra: full-art GX, TAG TEAM and its alternate arts, alternate art or Trainer), a rainbow or a gold. Pack: 1 Energy, 5 Common, 3 Uncommon, 1 reverse, 1 rare slot (TCGplayer product text '10 cards and 1 basic Energy', Bulbapedia Booster pack (TCG)). Cross-check only (not independent): ThePriceDex https://www.thepricedex.com/set/sm9/team-up/pull-rates. Pooled over 5,887 packs (sturzflug 2,016, burpies 872, Derium 2,999, Danny Phantump): GX 10.20% (1 in 9.8), full art 4.25% (1 in 23.5), holo Rare 16.50% (the rare slot is a plain Rare in exactly 2 packs in 3 and holo-or-better in 1 in 3, so holo is 1/3 minus the hits: sturzflug's direct counts of plain Rares in every Sun & Moon set are 66.5 to 67.0% (n=1,296 to 4,968 packs per set, https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/141 and following), confirmed in kind by the mappable-box reports, https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pokemon-sun-and-moon-booster-boxes-mappable/15673, and the code-card colour, Bulbapedia Code card; his own Team Up holo count is 16.56%), Prism Star 5.62% (1 in 17.8; burpies 5.97%, sturzflug 5.69%, Derium 5.47%). Rainbow 1.36% and gold 1.02% from E2's per-card counts (71 rainbow + 54 gold in 5,015 packs) pooled with burpies' split (1.03% / 0.69%, n=872). burpies is the low outlier on secrets (1.72% total against 2.3 to 2.7% elsewhere). No source splits TAG TEAM from single GX in measured pulls, so the GX roll is uniform over the 11 cards (5 TAG TEAM).

sm115.name: Hidden Fates
sm115.source: burpies, Elite Fourum 'Pull Rates in Sun & Moon - Sword & Shield Sets' (https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pull-rates-in-sun-moon-sword-shield-sets/25220), YouTube/Twitch box openings, 1,580 English packs, 95% CI: Rare Shiny 21.20% ±2.02, Rare Shiny GX 10.19% ±1.49 (the post's '1 in 8.81' is a typo for 1 in 9.8, the percentage is used), Rare Holo GX 15.06% ±1.76, Rare Ultra 4.87% ±1.06 (3 main-set full arts plus 6 Shiny Vault full-art Trainers; split 3.73% / 1.14% by ThePriceDex's ratio), Rare Rainbow 1.71% ±0.64, Shiny Vault gold Secret 1.77% ±0.65. Cross-checked against ThePriceDex's modelled table (https://www.thepricedex.com/set/sm115/hidden-fates/pull-rates: shiny 1 in 4.7, shiny GX 1 in 10.6, GX 1 in 6.7, rainbow 1 in 91, gold 1 in 63), which agrees within a point but is probably fitted to the same videos and is not independent; it is the only source for the holo Rare rate (1 in 5, 20%, single source). The Shiny Vault takes the reverse-holo slot (Bulbapedia on the Japanese parent set: a parallel foil is included unless the pack holds a regular Shiny Pokémon; the four vault tiers sum to 34.3%, about one pack in three, which fits one slot; Shining Fates precedent). Hidden Fates packs were never sold separately, only inside tins, pins, boxes and the ETB (pokemon.com via pocketmonsters.net/news/3686; Bulbapedia). Reverse-holo Energy (ThePriceDex 1 in 20, single source) is not modelled.

sm12.name: Cosmic Eclipse
sm12.source: Elite Fourum: sturzflugbombardieru's own box tallies, 3,024 packs (https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/140, box table read from the image; also /157 on the Character Rares) pooled with burpies' 3,136 packs, 95% CI (https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pull-rates-in-sun-moon-sword-shield-sets/25220): Rare Holo GX 12.37% (1 in 8), Rare Ultra full arts 3.74% (1 in 27; burpies 3.67% ±0.66), rainbow 1.50% ±0.43 (burpies only), gold Trainer/Energy 0.89% ±0.33 (burpies only), Character Rare 10.35% (sturzflug 3.90 per 36 packs, burpies 3.56), Rare Holo 14.31% (sturzflug only, single source). ThePriceDex (https://www.thepricedex.com/set/sm12/cosmic-eclipse/pull-rates) restates sturzflug's sheet model and is not independent; its values (GX 1 in 7.8, Ultra 1 in 26.2, rainbow 1 in 71.4, gold 1 in 111.1, character 1 in 10) agree within a pack or two. The twelve Character Rares (pkmn.gg files them as Rare Secret with the nine gold Trainers and the Energy) sit in the reverse slot (sturzflug: 'inserted separately' in the reverse sheets; ThePriceDex's reverse table sums to 1.007 only with them there). Danny Phantump's GX figure (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4TCjfoHoUqk) is an outlier and was not pooled.

det1.name: Detective Pikachu
det1.source: Four holofoil cards per pack, three Common Holo and one Rare Holo (Bulbapedia https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Detective_Pikachu_(TCG): every card is holo, packs could not be bought singly; sturzflugbombardieru, Elite Fourum https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/152, states the 3 + 1 split; ThePriceDex https://www.thepricedex.com/set/det1/detective-pikachu/pull-rates agrees but is a model). The rare slot is uniform over the ten Rares: sturzflugbombardieru's 75 rare pulls (Arcanine 11, Detective Pikachu 11, Ludicolo 10, Slaking 9, Charizard 7, Mr. Mime 7, Machamp 7, Ditto 7, Greninja 4, Mewtwo 2) give chi-square 10.2 on 9 degrees of freedom, no sign of short prints. burpies' 240-pack 'rare holo 37.08%' (Elite Fourum 25220) is not a per-pack rate and was not used. pkmn.gg's Rare / Rare Ultra labels are price tiers, not rarities.

sm35.name: Shining Legends
sm35.source: Eleven cards: basic Energy, 5 Commons, 3 Uncommons, a reverse slot and a rare slot that is always a holo or better (no plain Rare exists; TCGplayer group 2054 lists none, Elite Fourum, 'The English Pokemon card rarity guide' post 144 https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/144: 'all of these cards come in the rare slot'). Shining Pokemon are rare-slot cards, not reverse. GX 11.89%, full art 4.25%, secret total 2.45% and Shining 8.86%, pooled from burpies (n=1,536, Elite Fourum, 'Pull Rates in Sun & Moon - Sword & Shield Sets' (burpies, YouTube/Twitch box tally) https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pull-rates-in-modern-sets/25220), Derium (n=1,002) and sturzflugbombardieru's own boxes (n=330) as tallied in Elite Fourum, 'The English Pokemon card rarity guide' (sturzflugbombardieru: own full-box YouTube tallies pooled with Derium and Danny Phantump) https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/140. Rainbow 1.57% and the gold tube Mewtwo-GX 0.88%: the split follows E2's raw per-card counts (own + Derium n=1,332: rainbow 22, tube Mewtwo 11) and burpies (23 : 14), 45 : 25 pooled, from the second-source check (https://efour.b-cdn.net/uploads/default/original/3X/c/0/c0b6c315a3c260383181edd86f4951acdf46b8ad.png). Rare Holo is the remainder of the slot. Reverse basic Energy 7% of reverse slots (Derium 6.6%, E2 model 7.4%, ThePriceDex 1 in 14.3). Shining and reverse Energy are the least certain figures (small samples, one aggregator).

sm4.name: Crimson Invasion
sm4.source: Eleven cards: basic Energy, 5 Commons, 3 Uncommons, a reverse holo and a rare slot (plain Rare in 2 of 3 packs). GX 8.35%, full art 4.43% and secret total 2.13%: pooled tallies of sturzflugbombardieru's boxes (n=1,981, Elite Fourum, 'The English Pokemon card rarity guide' (sturzflugbombardieru: own full-box YouTube tallies pooled with Derium and Danny Phantump) https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/140), burpies (n=1,530, Elite Fourum, 'Pull Rates in Sun & Moon - Sword & Shield Sets' (burpies, YouTube/Twitch box tally) https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pull-rates-in-modern-sets/25220) and Derium (n=1,008), which agree within a point (GX 3.00, 2.99, 3.04 a box; Danny Phantump 3.06). Rainbow 1.04% and gold 1.09%: E2's raw per-card counts (own + Derium n=2,989: rainbow 30, gold 32) and burpies' 50/50 pool to 47 : 49, which is not the card-count rule's 61.5% rainbow (second-source check). second-source check of 2026-09-30 (/mnt/project-files/sun-moon/research/second-source-check.md): plain Rare counted at 66.5 to 67.0% of packs in every Sun & Moon main set from E2's per-card raw counts (1,296 to 4,968 packs per set; https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/145 and /146), and 'holo-or-better in every third pack' confirmed independently (Elite Fourum 'Sun and Moon Booster Boxes Mappable' https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pokemon-sun-and-moon-booster-boxes-mappable/15673; Player.One https://www.player.one/pokemon-sun-moon-booster-boxes-mapped-how-get-ultra-rare-or-holographic-every-time-584349), so Rare Holo = 1/3 minus the hits.

sm5.name: Ultra Prism
sm5.source: Eleven cards: basic Energy, 5 Commons, 3 Uncommons, a reverse slot and a rare slot. Prism Star cards replace the reverse holo (E2 posts 140 and 146 https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/146: 'Prism Star cards, which appear in the reverse slot'; PrimetimePokemon http://primetimepokemon.blogspot.com/2018/02/prism-star-cards-pokemon-tcg.html; PokeBeach 'Prism Star cards take the place of the Reverse Holo' https://www.pokebeach.com/forums/threads/forbidden-light-packs-with-5-prism-cards.147088/; and the rare-slot classes already sum to the packs opened without them). Pooled n=6,246 from E2's own boxes (n=2,844), burpies (n=1,674, Elite Fourum, 'Pull Rates in Sun & Moon - Sword & Shield Sets' (burpies, YouTube/Twitch box tally) https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pull-rates-in-modern-sets/25220), Derium (n=1,008) and Flipside Gaming's 720 packs (https://flipsidegaming.com/blogs/pokemon-blog/a-review-of-rarity-in-ultra-prism, quoted at https://www.elitefourum.com/t/official-pull-rates/20546): GX 8.17%, full art 4.14%, Prism Star 8.50%; rainbow 1.47% and gold 0.81% from E2's raw counts (own + Derium n=3,852: rainbow 58, gold 33) and burpies (25 : 13). second-source check of 2026-09-30 (/mnt/project-files/sun-moon/research/second-source-check.md): plain Rare counted at 66.5 to 67.0% of packs in every Sun & Moon main set from E2's per-card raw counts (1,296 to 4,968 packs per set; https://www.elitefourum.com/t/39762/145 and /146), and 'holo-or-better in every third pack' confirmed independently (Elite Fourum 'Sun and Moon Booster Boxes Mappable' https://www.elitefourum.com/t/pokemon-sun-and-moon-booster-boxes-mappable/15673; Player.One https://www.player.one/pokemon-sun-moon-booster-boxes-mapped-how-get-ultra-rare-or-holographic-every-time-584349), so Rare Holo = 1/3 minus the hits.
